conditions.L0: runnability is an upstream execution condition
conditions.V: observer and replay are cross-cutting validity conditions for instrumented budget and path evidence

claim_rule.execution_claim_admissible: L0, V, L1, L2, and L3 are PASS

protocol_invariants.evidence_conservation: local_status is immutable during effective-status derivation
protocol_invariants.blocking_monotonicity: downstream observations cannot increase highest_admissible_layer while an upstream prerequisite is nonpassing
protocol_invariants.repair_isolation: a repaired evidence object must use a new versioned case_id
protocol_invariants.idempotence: repeated derivation returns the same effective_claim_status and highest_admissible_layer
